verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback widget lets users submit in-app feedback (foreloop-docs-9, foreloop-docs-11, foreloop-docs-18, foreloop-docs-29), but there is no evidence of a public-facing portal where customers can browse and vote on ideas — submissions instead route to an internal project or feedback list for triage by an agent. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The story's subject is a hosted public portal where customers submit AND vote; the evidenced embed widget is submit-only with private routing, and the rationale concedes no portal and no voting exist in the pack. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
